answer: Make identities expensive to multiply by tying grading weight to stake that unbonds slowly, then cap how much any one stake cluster can grade per epoch. A sybil farm that tries to echo its own answers hits the cap and its correlated scores get flagged by comparing against random independent panels. Cheap identities become a fable: each fake needs its own opal-rare bonded deposit, and losing it to slashing when collusion is detected makes the attack cost more than it earns.
